## Git discipline (non-negotiable)

More than one person and more than one agent work in this repo at the same time. The universal rules (branch from `origin/{{DEFAULT_BRANCH}}`, stage named paths, never commit on `{{DEFAULT_BRANCH}}`, never rewrite pushed history) reach every session from the ai-infra plugin; below is what is specific to this tree.

0. **Work in your own worktree, not the shared checkout.** Several sessions share one directory, so they share one checked-out branch and one index; a `git checkout` in another session moves YOU mid-task, and no rule you follow can prevent that. `./scripts/new_worktree.sh <branch-name>` makes one from `origin/{{DEFAULT_BRANCH}}` and refuses to run without a reachable remote. What a worktree does NOT isolate: {{SHARED_STATE}} — shared by every session, so two agents can still collide on data when their files cannot. Coordinate before running anything that writes there.
1. **One PR per idea, and never self-merge blind.** `gh pr view --json files,commits` and confirm it contains your commits and only your commits. A PR carrying a commit you did not write is a mis-branched PR: stop and fix the branch.
2. **Review before merge.** See [Review](#review).

## Review

Every change is reviewed before merge: by a human, or by the `pr-reviewer` agent (ai-infra plugin) reviewing the diff with fresh eyes. It reads *Things that surprise people* above as its trap list and posts findings with `gh pr comment`. Merging unreviewed work is acceptable only for a change whose full blast radius fits in one sentence, and the PR must say it went unreviewed.

## Docs

- When you change behaviour, update the doc in the same commit. If you cannot fix it fully, still fix the wrong sentence; a half-updated doc beats a confidently wrong one.
- No PROGRESS.md, TODO.md or status file in this tree: anything an agent updates more often than it commits goes stale and misleads (one sat 19 days stale while the repo shipped daily, 2026-08-25). Session state lives in `.claude/state/` (git-excluded): `MAP.md` from the scout, `HANDOFF.md` from `/handover`.
